measurement.strict_event: Current native goal with frozen authored item/target binding, same actor, legal successful event; no name rebinding.
measurement.physical: Recursive possession for Get/Steal; exact Give/Put destination; exact wear/wield mode; own bound consumption into VOID. Drop/Remove have only strict events.
measurement.initial: Physical predicates already true in source are explicitly separate; not evidence of newly induced cooperation.
measurement.joint: Both original atomic events or, for Get/Steal only, material acquisition. Not agreement, complete purpose, mutual benefit or cooperation success.
measurement.unknown: Unbound/nonimplemented predicates remain null and leave that metric denominator; all episodes remain.

bootstrap.within_graph: mean over original pairs and fixed seeds

cost.scope: Final occupied slots use launcher start_epoch→end_epoch and include process shutdown; launch→original runtime mtime is retained separately as a lower observation. Runtime load/run sub-timers remain separate. All supplied profile/full costs counted once; exact duplicate episodes add no samples.

scope: Both roles use this model. Profile is one technical case, not a population result. Original quests are independent annotations on the same original graph. No uniform cooperation label.
